{{Quote|All I can say is it's a mercy Orko is paying for it.|Gorga expresses his relief at the fact his father in law is paying for his wedding feast|<ref name="BF:WTFLS" />}}
'''Slimps' eyes''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Thirty crates of the best Slimps' [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] available were purchased in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] by [[Orko]] the [[H'uun]], a member of a low caste of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The crates were served at the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] feast of his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] [[Anachro]] and the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]. The feast was incredibly expensive due to the food served.<ref name="BF:WTFLS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slimps' eyes were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] ''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]'', which was written by [[John Wagner]] and published in [[1996]]. While the images of the feast that were shown in the comic include many kinds of food, it was not made clear if any of them were supposed to be the eyes.<ref name="BF:WTFLS" />
